title: 第十章 琼羽真尊
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
首次御剑，谢清猗虽不恐高，却仍被那惊人的速度惊出一身冷汗，她总算切身体会到，何为真正的’风驰电掣’。

    飞剑快得远超想象，凛冽罡风扑面压来，她不仅无法张口，甚至连半点声音都无法发出，更遑论分神去欣赏飞剑下速退的建筑，只觉眼前景物模糊成一片流动的色彩，耳边唯有呼啸的风声。

    剑光倏然一敛，便稳稳落在一处开阔的青石空地上，身旁是一池碧波，荷花亭亭初绽，池畔叠着几座嶙峋的太湖石假山。

    先前那惊心动魄的极速，霎时归于一片静谧，唯有池面被剑气余波荡开的涟漪。

    待跳下飞剑，谢清猗才发觉自己双脚绵软，如同踩在云端般，心脏仍在胸腔里狂跳不止，头脑晕眩，好像刚喝了酒一般。

    回过神后，她心中惊叹：真是刺激！这速度也太快了吧～感觉就一眨眼的功夫。

    幸而安芦冉并未察觉她的异样，这可多亏了她前世作为极限运动爱好者那份硬核的心理素质。

    安芦冉步履轻盈在前引路，谢清猗紧随其后，此处距谢家正殿尚有一段距离，抄手游廊蜿蜒通向深处，廊外一片青翠竹林随风摇曳，轻响声滤去了远处隐约的人声。

    想到等下要见的人，她默想着，按照她现在修为来推算，对应原书剧情，也就是说，一切才刚刚起始。

    原身如今金丹中期，而女主千沐妍尚在金丹初期，待她中期时，将借秘境副本以丹药讨好男主，正式引动’天极双姝’的剧情。她可绝对不会配合出境。

    等女主修至金丹中期，她早已是金丹大圆满。那些原小说中的爱恨纠葛的情节，应当就与她没什么关系了吧。

    绕过一扇巨大的云母屏风，穿过月洞门，眼前豁然开朗的景象令她不由驻足。

    远处飞阁流丹，层楼叠榭，檐角在灵雾中若隐若现，而面前是整块巨大青玉雕成的山水影壁，矗立道中，其上云海松涛栩栩如生。

    廊檐下，琉璃灯盏中嵌着的夜明珠散发出温润皎洁的光华，将四周映照得如梦似幻。

    她心中不由再次暗叹，这真的只是修仙界的三流世家吗？那些真正的顶级世家，不知道能有多夸张，看看以后有没有机会去见识下……

    谢清猗抬眼望去，大殿中央立着一位身材高大，看似三十出头的男子，她立刻在记忆中对上号，这便是原身的大伯，现任谢家家主谢临坤。他神色威严，不苟言笑，一身墨青法袍衬得气场愈发沉凝。

    在他身旁，那个笑得双眼眯成缝，身材微胖的中年人，便是最爱欺负原身的小叔谢临浩。

    单看外表，谢临浩眼角的细纹与略显臃肿的身形，反倒比挺拔的谢临坤更像长了一辈。

    谢清猗不动声色地扫过他们身侧，大伯右边站着气质沉静的大堂姐谢昕儿，小叔左边则是眼眶微红，神情各异的谢之涵与低眉顺眼的谢之妙。

    殿内灵烛高烧，将众人身影映在光洁如镜的玄晶地面上。
content_en:
It was the first time she wielded a sword. Although Xie Qingyi was not afraid of heights, she was still broken into a cold sweat by the astonishing speed. She finally realized firsthand what it meant to be truly 'quick and lightning'.

    The flying sword was far faster than imagined, and the fierce wind was blowing against her face. Not only was she unable to open her mouth, she couldn't even make a sound, let alone being distracted to admire the rapidly retreating buildings below the flying sword. She felt that the scenery in front of her was blurred into a flowing color, and the only sound in her ears was the whistling wind.

    The sword's light suddenly converged and landed firmly on an open bluestone clearing. Next to it was a pool of blue waves, with lotus blossoms blooming, and several rugged Taihu stone rockeries stacked beside the pool.

    The thrilling speed before suddenly returned to silence, with only the ripples on the surface of the pool caused by the aftermath of the sword energy.

    After jumping off the flying sword, Xie Qingyi realized that his feet were soft, as if he were stepping on clouds, his heart was still beating wildly in his chest, and his head was dizzy, as if he had just drank alcohol.

    After coming back to her senses, she exclaimed in her heart: How exciting! This speed is too fast~ It feels like it takes the blink of an eye.

    Fortunately, An Luran didn't notice anything strange about her. This was thanks to her hard-core mentality as an extreme sports enthusiast in her previous life.

    An Luran led the way with light steps, followed closely by Xie Qingyi. This place was still some distance away from the main hall of the Xie family. The hand-cooked verandah winded to the depths. Outside the veranda, a green bamboo forest swayed in the wind, and the soft sound filtered out the faint human voices in the distance.

    Thinking of the person she was going to meet later, she thought silently. Based on her current cultivation level, it corresponded to the plot of the original book. In other words, everything had just begun.

    The original body is now in the middle stage of the golden elixir, while the heroine Qian Muyan is still in the early stage of the golden elixir. When she is in the middle stage, she will use the secret realm dungeon to please the male protagonist with elixirs, officially triggering the plot of "Two Shus in Heaven". She will never cooperate with leaving the country.

    By the time the female major reaches the middle stage of the Golden Elixir, she has already attained the Great Perfection of the Golden Elixir. Those love-hate plots in the original novel should have nothing to do with her.

    After bypassing a huge mica screen and passing through the moon cave door, the sight that suddenly opened up in front of her made her stop in her tracks.

    In the distance, there are flying pavilions and pavilions, and the corners of the eaves are looming in the spiritual mist. In front of you is a landscape screen wall made of a huge green jade, standing in the middle of the road, with sea of ​​clouds and pine waves on it lifelike.

    Under the eaves of the corridor, the luminous pearls embedded in the glazed lamps emit a warm and bright brilliance, illuminating the surroundings like a dream.

    She couldn't help but secretly sigh again, was this really just a third-rate family in the world of immortality? I don’t know how exaggerated those truly top aristocratic families can be. Let’s see if there is a chance to see them in the future...

    Xie Qingyi raised her eyes and saw a tall man in his early thirties standing in the center of the hall. She immediately recognized it in her memory. This was her original uncle and the current head of the Xie family, Xie Linkun. He looked majestic and serious, and his dark green robe made his aura even more solemn.

    Next to him, the middle-aged man who smiled so hard that his eyes narrowed and he was slightly fat, was Xie Linhao, his uncle who loved to bully him the most.

    Looking at appearance alone, Xie Linhao's fine lines at the corners of his eyes and his slightly bloated body look more like he is a generation older than the tall and straight Xie Linkun.

    Xie Qingyi swept past them calmly. On the uncle's right stood the calm and calm cousin Xie Xin'er. On the left of the uncle stood Xie Zhihan with slightly red eyes and different expressions and Xie Zhimiao with a low eyebrow.

    The spiritual candles in the hall were burning high, reflecting the figures of everyone on the mirror-like black crystal ground.
